description:
Repro (0a1d44728): dbg(apply(fn a, b -> a + b end, [1, 2])) -> error[lower/unbound]: compiler2 lowering found unresolved direct runtime callee apply/2. Elixir prints 3. No apply/2 exists in lib/ or src/; apply/3 is a defmacro in lib/kernel.fz:238.
Done when: an oracle fixture calls apply/2 with an anonymous function, a captured function (&String.upcase/1) and a closure, with zero, one and several arguments, and matches Elixir on interp, run and build; a list whose length does not match the function's arity raises as Elixir does (BadArityError) or the ticket records why not.
title: apply/2 calls a function value with a list of arguments
